layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-24 for sections. Use grid layout for products and stats.
layout.shadows: shadow-sm for subtle elevation, avoid large soft shadows to maintain a strict corporate look.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-1 and shadow enhancement on product cards. Slow ease-in-out.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up for sections using motion.div.

components.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white border-b border-gray-200, solid background. No glassmorphism to keep it corporate.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No neon, no generic purple/teal. Use Deep Navy, Steel Gray, White, and Pharmaceutical Green.
Use IBM Plex Sans for headings and Karla for body text. Install using Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Keep the UI industrial, premium, and clean. Emphasize straight lines, subtle borders, and minimal border-radius (rounded-sm or none).
Avoid standard SaaS bloat. It should look like a multi-million dollar B2B enterprise (think Siemens or GE Healthcare).
Use the provided image URLs appropriately for hero sections, products, and facilities.
Use Framer Motion for smooth enterprise-grade reveals (e.g., fade-in-up) but do not over-animate. Keep it professional.
Include Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to match the strict corporate/industrial theme (remove excessive rounding and shadows).
